title: Stratford Square Mall
content: The movie theater and food court are especially recognizable to me. I’m kinda spooked because I’ve been to these places almost every night for years, and seeing them on my screen as a fucking picture is a lil too surreal. I’ve been trying to keep the daytime recognition theory in mind (the whole “have you seen this man?” phenomena + surrounding studies which attributed it to faulty memory combined with a suggestion that could fill the gap), but I really don’t believe that this applies here: I remember these places as if I actually am visiting them every night and I know a lot of you can attest to that. Soooooo please lmk if you’ve experienced this because I feel like I’m going insane 😀
